project_specification.overview: NULLIUS is a recursively self-improving research system that discovers predictive signals in crypto markets using only free CEX data. It treats completed discovery history as a replay simulator for cheap off-policy evaluation of exploration policies, and makes that port viable by planting hidden null hypotheses at the evaluation layer so the corruption rate of a corruptible evaluator can be measured rather than assumed. The product is not a strategy: it is a calibrated search-and-select policy with a known, measured false discovery rate.
project_specification.target_audience: One expert quantitative operator running the system daily for years. They read epistemic state, not profit: the headline number is FDR_deploy, never a backtest Sharpe. They are the only human in the loop and they own the hypothesis space, the portfolio construction, and every promotion decision.

backend.validation: Pydantic Settings + YAML, typed and hashable
backend.parallelism: multiprocessing, with Ray only if scaling past one machine
backend.exchange_client: hand-rolled over ccxt, preserving microstructure detail

database.primary: PostgreSQL 16 for the tree store, trial ledger and replay scores

communication.api_style: Internal REST between services; no public API surface
communication.response_format: JSON envelope with data, error and status keys

infrastructure.sandbox: gVisor runsc for all LLM-authored code
infrastructure.containers: Docker, digest-pinned, because evaluator_hash requires digests not tags
infrastructure.orchestration: cron + systemd first; Prefect only when cron hurts
infrastructure.avoided: Kubernetes, Kafka, and any feature-store SaaS

project_specification.prerequisites: - Python 3.12+ with uv installed, workspace members under packages/ - PostgreSQL 16 reachable via DATABASE_URL - Docker with gVisor runsc runtime available for sandboxed execution - Local disk for the data lake, sized 1-3 TB for Parquet snapshots - Exchange REST/websocket access; read + trade keys only, withdrawal disabled - KMS or sops for the null sidecar key, granted to one service account - Environment variables documented in .env.example: DATABASE_URL, LAKE_ROOT, NULL_SIDECAR_KEY_REF, EXCHANGE_KEY_REF, PROVIDER_FIXTURE_DIR - No GPU anywhere; GPU is prohibited in both the evaluation and replay paths by the determinism contract, and replay invokes no model inference of any kind

feature.description: System persists a root pyproject.toml declaring every workspace member under packages/, so parallel agents never invent competing project layouts
System creates an application factory whose module loader scans packages for registered components, which returns a composed app object without any component editing the factory
System provides shared pytest configuration with fixtures for a temporary lake root, so every workspace package runs its suite with test_database_url isolation
System defines a MarketWindow class whose constructor persists a decision time t as a read-only attribute that no caller can reassign
System exposes MarketWindow.bars for 1m, 1h and 1d frequencies, which returns a Polars frame containing no row later than the window decision time
System exposes MarketWindow.trades over a lookback in seconds, which returns aggregated trade rows truncated at the decision time
System exposes MarketWindow.bookfeat by feature name, which returns derived order-book features at 1 second resolution
System exposes MarketWindow.borrow which returns margin borrow rate rows used as a real-time crowding proxy
System exposes MarketWindow.feature taking a name plus an explicit version, which returns rows for that exact version only
System rejects any MarketWindow accessor that receives a timestamp argument, because no timestamp a caller passes may widen the window
System declares the signal entrypoint taking a MarketWindow plus an integer seed, which returns a Polars series indexed by symbol
System rejects a signal return value whose index contains a symbol absent from the window universe, which emits a contract_violation outcome
System exposes MarketWindow.universe as a tuple, which returns symbols tradable as of the decision time rather than as of the current wall clock
System serializes a materialized MarketWindow to Arrow IPC so the sandbox receives data over a payload channel with zero_copy transfer
System versions the signal ABI with a contract_version constant that every stored node persists alongside its code hash
System isolates each stream class in its own ingest worker, which returns a per-stream failure rather than halting all ingest
System ingests 1m, 1h and 1d klines from REST backfill plus a websocket tail, persisting rows into the staging area
System ingests aggTrades from the websocket feed, persisting compressed rows retained permanently
System ingests L2 book diffs at 100 millisecond resolution, persisting raw diffs under a rolling 90 day retention window
System computes derived book features at 1 second resolution from L2 diffs, persisting depth at 5, 10, 25 and 50 bps per side
System computes microprice, spread and order-flow imbalance over several windows, persisting each as a permanently retained book feature
System computes cancel-replace rate plus trade-size distribution moments, persisting them so a 90 day raw-diff expiry does not lose the derived history
System ingests funding rate and margin borrow rate every 60 seconds, persisting rows retained permanently
System ingests exchangeInfo filters daily, persisting each fetch as a new version rather than overwriting the prior one
System detects a websocket sequence-number gap on reconnect, which emits a gap_detected event naming the affected stream
System backfills a detected websocket gap over REST before the next snapshot seals, which rejects a seal attempt while any gap stays open
System rejects an incoming Parquet batch whose columns drifted from the declared schema
System persists all ingest output append-only into a staging area that never appears on the evaluator mount path
System restarts an ingest worker safely after a crash, resuming from the last persisted sequence with no duplicate rows
System persists a sealed snapshot into an immutable directory named by sealed_at plus a hash prefix
System persists a MANIFEST.json per snapshot recording per-file sha256, row counts and the universe definition
System persists snapshot_hash computed as a sha256 over sorted file hashes plus the universe definition plus the schema version
System persists each sealed snapshot into the snapshot_manifest record so a score can name the exact bytes it was computed over
System mounts a sealed snapshot read-only, which rejects any write attempt against a sealed path with a permission error message
System rejects an evaluator request naming a staging path, because staging is never on the evaluator mount path
System verifies a snapshot on open by recomputing file hashes, which emits a corruption alert when any recorded sha256 fails to match
System partitions snapshot bars by symbol and date, so a query at one date returns only the relevant Parquet files
System assigns a new snapshot_hash when the lake is extended, which invalidates previously cached scores rather than silently reusing them
System persists a recomputation flag on every score affected by a snapshot change, while the discovery tree structure survives intact
System persists a monthly tradable universe computed as top-N by 30 day median dollar volume
System persists universe_membership rows carrying symbol, valid_from, valid_to and delist_reason
System resolves universe membership as of a requested decision time, which returns the symbols tradable then rather than now
System retains delisted symbols with their full price history, which returns them in any window covering their listed period
System emits a survivorship audit report counting delisted symbols present in each historical window
System rejects a universe build whose delisted-symbol count is 0 across a period known to contain delistings
System returns a stable symbol ordering from every universe resolution, so downstream reductions stay bit-reproducible
System excludes symbols whose 30 day median dollar volume falls below a configured floor, persisting the exclusion reason
System keys every stored feature with feature_name, feature_version, snapshot_hash, symbol and frequency
System materializes a feature to Parquet lazily on first request, persisting the result for later reuse
System returns a cached feature on subsequent requests without recomputation, measured by a cache_hit counter
System stamps every feature row with computed_as_of at write time
System returns only rows whose computed_as_of is at or before the query time, so a point-in-time read cannot see a later computation
System persists rows under a new feature_version when a definition changes, leaving prior-version rows untouched
System treats a feature_version bump as invalidating dependent scores, which emits the same recomputation signal an evaluator change produces
System computes multi-horizon realized volatility plus volatility-of-volatility, persisting each as a versioned regime feature
System computes cross-sectional return dispersion plus return autocorrelation at several lags, persisting them with feature_version stamps
System computes mean pairwise correlation of the top 50 symbols plus breadth above an N-day moving average, persisting both
System labels market regimes using a rolling-window fit only, which rejects any labeler configured to fit over full history
System persists the resolved cost model version string with its venue name after loading the YAML configuration
System persists cost_model_hash computed over the loaded configuration, so every score names its fee assumptions
System applies taker and maker fees in basis points per venue, which returns a post-cost return series
System applies a discount-token fee reduction when configured, which returns an effective 7.5 bps rate in place of 10 bps
System fills a passive order only when the recorded tape trades through the quoted price, which rejects fills that merely touch it
System charges a queue-position penalty in basis points on every passive fill, so a zero-maker venue still returns a nonzero cost
System models passive fill probability as exponential decay against queue depth, which returns a fill fraction per rebalance
System walks the recorded L2 book for an aggressive order rather than crossing at the midpoint, which returns a realistic slippage figure
System persists an empirical p50, p95 and p99 latency distribution measured from shadow runs rather than an assumed constant
System sources borrow cost from the recorded exchange borrow rate series, which returns a carry adjustment per holding period
System rejects a second implementation of the fee schedule, so research evaluation and live execution import one shared cost library
System persists evaluator_hash computed as a sha256 over the container image digest plus the resolved configuration
System rejects a comparison between two scores whose evaluator_hash values differ, which returns a mismatched_provenance error message
System resolves the evaluation window host-side by slicing a sealed snapshot to the decision time, which returns a point-in-time universe
System executes the signal function inside the sandbox, which returns a raw score vector per rebalance date
System normalizes a raw score vector by ranking then cross-sectional z-scoring, which returns a comparable score regardless of author scale
System aligns forward returns at horizons of 1, 2, 5, 10 and 20 periods, which returns one target series per horizon
System rejects a target substitution anywhere outside the null_gate step, which is the only place the oracle supplies a target series
System rejects a cross-validation fold whose holding period is not purged at the split boundary
System embargoes the lookback length after every split boundary, which rejects a fold configuration whose embargo is 0 periods
System applies the cost model to the aligned returns, persisting a post-cost signal return series per symbol
System computes ic_mean, ic_tstat, ir_standalone and turnover, persisting each as a scalar on the node record
System computes a decay profile measuring information coefficient at each of the five horizons, persisting it as a stored array
System computes a capacity estimate plus regime attribution, persisting both into the node artifact directory
System computes ir_marginal by orthogonalizing the candidate against the current book, which returns the incremental information ratio
System persists an irreversible trial charge with its failure outcome even when the evaluation failed, because a failed evaluation still consumed a hypothesis
System persists the full artifact to the artifact store plus the scalar metrics to the tree store as the final pipeline step
System persists one trial_ledger row per evaluation under a monotonically increasing sequence number
System stamps every trial_ledger row with evaluator_hash, snapshot_hash and cost_model_hash
System records epoch_id naming which sequestered epoch a trial charged, which rejects a write whose epoch_id is absent
System stamps every trial row with charge_units defaulting to 1.0, so a cross-validated evaluation can cost more than one unit
System stamps every trial row with charges_budget supplied by the null oracle as an opaque directive, never as a derived label
System persists an outcome of ok, timeout, error or tripwire_fail on every appended trial row
System rejects any UPDATE or DELETE against trial_ledger, enforced by role grants rather than by application convention
System derives K_effective per epoch by counting only rows with charges_budget true, so null nodes never inflate the trial count
System exposes GET /ledger/k-effective which returns K_effective per epoch as the deflation input
System exposes POST /ledger/debit appending one trial row idempotently keyed by node_id, which returns the prior sequence on a retry
System derives epoch usage counts from the epoch_ledger, which returns how many promotion decisions each sequestered epoch has served
System creates the node table with a primary key id, a self-referencing parent_id foreign key, campaign_id, theme_root and depth columns
System creates the code_hash, stated_mechanism and artifact_uri columns on the node table in a versioned migration
System creates the evaluator_hash, snapshot_hash and cost_model_hash columns on the node table as the stored provenance triple
System creates the agent_model_id, agent_ckpt_hash and agent_sampling columns on the node table so a pool can be stratified by authoring model
System creates the ic_mean, ic_tstat, ir_standalone, ir_marginal, turnover, cost_adjusted_ir and perturb_stability columns on the node table
System creates an index on node campaign_id with parent_id, plus an index on code_hash for deduplication and one on agent_model_id
System creates the trial_ledger table with a bigserial primary key and role grants that deny UPDATE and DELETE
System creates the campaign table recording campaign type, workspace count, null fraction and calibration_status
System creates the epoch_ledger table tracking promotion decisions served per sequestered epoch with a unique constraint on epoch_id
System creates the replay_score table plus the policy_revision table recording policy version, world id, beta and committed pick
System creates the regime_coverage table counting stored worlds per regime stratum
System creates the forward_record, promotion_registry, universe_membership and snapshot_manifest tables in one versioned migration
System persists null assignments in an AES-GCM encrypted sidecar file readable by exactly one service account
System keeps is_null absent from the tree store entirely, which rejects any proposed node column named is_null
System resolves the sidecar decryption key from KMS or sops, which emits an unrecoverable_state alert when decryption fails
System exposes POST /target accepting node_id, campaign_id, depth, horizon, symbols and a date range, which returns 200 for a known node

System returns responses whose shape and timing are identical for null and real nodes, so a caller cannot distinguish the two branches

System scores a candidate against time-shuffled forward returns, which rejects the node when a surviving Sharpe indicates leakage

System persists a tripwire failure as poisoning the node together with its entire subtree

System maintains a corpus of deliberately leaking signals that every tripwire must catch, which returns 0 escapes in the suite
System computes the area under the curve for perturbation stability separating planted nulls from real signals, which emits the triage figure
System pins every evaluation container by image digest rather than by tag, which rejects a tag-only reference
System pins library versions with a lockfile inside the image, which rejects any runtime package installation attempt

System sets PYTHONHASHSEED to 0 and applies explicit sorts before every reduction, which returns a stable iteration order
System rejects a searched-code import of time, datetime.now or unseeded random through the import allowlist

System persists a frozen canary policy together with a frozen canary tree as the determinism reference pair
System replays the canary pair nightly, which returns a score compared against a recorded constant
System halts dreaming when the canary score differs from the recorded constant by more than 1e-12, which emits a determinism_broken alert
System persists a void marker on every score produced after a detected determinism break, rather than letting bad data age into good data
System asserts bit-identical output across two runs of the same seeded signal, which returns a byte-level comparison result
System rejects a model inference call made from the replay path, because replay reads materialized values rather than computing them
System mounts the immutable zone read-only for every service, which rejects a write attempt with a permission error message
System grants loop-mutated components a credential set that rejects every write to the immutable zone
System denies all egress from sandboxes by default, which rejects any attempt to reach the data lake over the network
System places the provider API call outside the sandbox in the orchestrator, which sends code in and takes code out

System provisions exchange keys with trade permission but with withdrawal permanently disabled, which returns a validation failure otherwise
System uses separate credentials per environment, so a shadow sub-account key returns 401 against the live account
System persists an access audit record per read of the null sidecar key, which exactly one service account may request

System rejects access to the live trading host that does not arrive through a bastion session, because no inbound port is exposed
System rejects a run of agent-authored code configured without gVisor isolation

System applies a seccomp syscall allowlist, which rejects a process attempting a disallowed syscall

System rejects a sandboxed run exceeding the cgroup limits for cpu, memory of 2048 MB or a process count of 32
System persists a timeout fail class after hard-killing a sandboxed run that exceeded its 30 second wall clock budget
System rejects a sandbox invocation missing the thread-pinning environment
System passes the node seed into every sandboxed invocation, persisting that seed on the node record
System transfers the materialized window as Arrow IPC, which returns the resulting score vector over the same channel
System rejects a submitted module importing anything outside the configured allowlist, which returns a disallowed_import error message
System returns a structured fail class of ok, timeout, error or tripwire_fail from every sandboxed run
System persists one artifact directory per node keyed by campaign_id then node_id
System persists signal_returns as Parquet per symbol and period after costs, which is what lets replay recompute marginal contribution
System persists ic_series and turnover_series as Parquet files inside the node artifact directory
System persists decay_profile and regime_attribution as JSON inside the node artifact directory
System persists the executed signal source plus an execution trace alongside every stored artifact

System pins each loaded campaign array in memory, holding roughly 4 MB per campaign of 500 nodes
System declines to cache marginal information ratio against canonical books, caching the return series instead

System exposes a symbolic regression world, which returns a ground-truth score against known target expressions

System persists the fetched exchangeInfo version carrying lot size, notional, price filter, step size and tick size
System refreshes exchangeInfo filters daily, which rejects any hardcoded venue constant in the order path
System rejects an order submission not rounded to the venue step size and tick size
System rejects an order falling below the venue minimum notional, which returns a below_min_notional error message
System posts orders passively by default, which sends an aggressive order only when signal decay horizon is shorter than expected fill time
System uses isolated margin per book, which rejects a cross-margin configuration that would merge independent positions
System derives a client order identifier by hashing book id, rebalance timestamp and symbol, which returns an idempotent resubmission key
System returns the prior result for a duplicate client order identifier rather than placing a second order
System applies a token-bucket rate limiter matched to the venue weight schedule, which returns remaining headroom per request
System retries a rate-limited request with exponential backoff plus jitter, which emits one retry event per attempt
System persists order submission health independently of feed health, running the router in its own process
System rejects live order submission without an explicit flag, defaulting to shadow mode against a sub-account
System runs the risk supervisor as a separate process, which sends a kill instruction to the order layer
System exposes POST /risk/halt, which flattens open positions and rejects new order submission
System rejects further orders once account equity falls below twice the venue minimum notional, rather than degrading into untradeable dust
System rejects new orders until a manual reset once the configured daily loss limit is breached
System persists an automatic demotion when live information coefficient falls below 40 percent of its backtest value
System requires a statistically meaningful observation window before auto-demotion fires, which rejects a demotion on a thin sample
System rejects new orders while holding positions when data feed staleness exceeds the configured threshold
System persists the measured clock skew that halted trading when it exceeded the threshold against exchange server time
System flattens successfully even when the strategy process is hung, which returns a completed flatten result
System persists every halt event with its trigger reason and timestamp for later reconciliation
System exposes POST /forward/promote, which creates a forward_record carrying the promotion timestamp
System persists one forward_record per promoted signal carrying live information coefficient observations over time
System exposes GET /forward/decay which returns the observed decay curve for a promoted signal
System persists each forward observation over a 90 day track computed only on data that did not exist when the hypothesis was formed
System rejects a purge configuration for forward data, because the record is out of sample by construction
System computes forward information coefficient retention as live divided by backtest, which returns the ratio per signal
System persists the revised beta-four value per cycle, fed back from observed sim-reality divergence
System updates decay priors from observed forward half-life, which returns revised inputs to campaign planning
System reconciles realized fill costs against modeled costs in basis points, persisting the difference per rebalance
System exposes GET /metrics/fdr-deploy which returns the base-rate reweighted false discovery rate as the top-line figure
System exposes GET /metrics/instrument-status which returns canary, KS guard and ingest lag as three binary lamps
System exposes GET /metrics/regime-coverage which returns stored world counts per stratum
System persists sensitivity and specificity on planted nulls per campaign into the metrics store
System persists Type-B depth past the flip for Type-D worlds, which returns the trend across campaigns
System persists discoveries per 1000 budget-charging trials, excluding null nodes from the denominator
System persists the train-versus-holdout world score gap as the meta-overfitting indicator
System emits one structured log record per evaluation carrying the full provenance triple plus node_id and campaign_id
System emits one structured log record per replay carrying policy version, world id, beta, score and committed pick
System persists live metrics covering information coefficient ratio, fill cost in basis points, order reject rate and feed staleness
System renders a Streamlit dashboard whose primary panel displays FDR_deploy rather than an equity curve
System displays the remaining clean epoch count in permanent dashboard chrome, so depletion stays visible
System rejects the merge when agent-writable paths overlap the immutable zone, enforcing the first stated invariant
System rejects the merge when any symbol named is_null is reachable outside the scorer package
System rejects the merge when the policy interface exposes an unrevealed score to a prefix-only caller
System rejects the merge when an epoch exceeding three promotion decisions remains selectable
System rejects the merge when a stored score lacks any member of the provenance triple
System rejects the merge when a node record carries no agent_model_id value
System rejects the merge when a regime labeler is configured with a full-history fit
System rejects the merge when promotion criteria are recorded after the deciding evaluation
System rejects the merge when a role holding UPDATE or DELETE on trial_ledger exists
System rejects the merge when the evaluator image hash differs from the recorded pinned digest
System passes an end-to-end test where ingest seals a snapshot, the evaluator scores a hand-written momentum signal, and the run returns positive information coefficient with a persisted node row
System passes an end-to-end test where a random signal returns an information coefficient indistinguishable from zero across the sealed snapshot
System passes an end-to-end test where a deliberately leaking signal trips every tripwire, and the replay pool returns 0 surviving nodes from that branch
System passes an end-to-end test where a planted-null campaign completes and the KS guard returns a p-value above 0.05
System passes an end-to-end test where a full campaign runs under fixed exploration against fixture-backed agents, which returns baseline sensitivity and specificity
System passes an end-to-end test where a dreaming cycle over a seeded bootstrap pool selects a policy revision and persists a replay_score row per pair
System passes an end-to-end test where a promoted signal flows through book construction into a shadow order, and the venue returns 200 for a filter-compliant submission
System passes an end-to-end test where a daily loss breach drives the risk supervisor to flatten positions while the strategy process is unresponsive, which returns a completed flatten

project_specification.ui_layout: Operator surface is a Streamlit dashboard reading the Postgres metrics table, which is the simpler option the architecture explicitly permits at this scale. The primary panel is FDR_deploy with its provenance triple; instrument status lamps and the remaining clean epoch count sit in permanent chrome. The full operator console specified in docs/design.md — the assay-plate vernacular, the confidence treatment, blinded and read modes — is deliberately out of scope for this spec and will be specified separately once the data model is real.
project_specification.design_system: No visual design system is in scope here. The one binding presentation rule carried over from the architecture is that the top-line number is FDR_deploy and never an equity curve; any panel that would promote profit above epistemic state is rejected at review.

key_interactions.interaction: Orchestrator plans a grid from prior manifests, asserts at least three theme roots, assigns null status through the oracle, expands the tree across W workers, and seals a manifest.

Host slices a sealed snapshot to t, the sandbox executes the signal, the oracle supplies the target series with an opaque budget directive, costs and purged folds apply, tripwires run, the ledger is debited, and the artifact is persisted.

Pool is frozen, the policy agent writes M revisions, each replays across every stored world without touching the evaluator, scores aggregate as regime-stratified CVaR, and the argmax is selected against the meta-selection bar on a rotated holdout.
Criteria are pre-registered and hashed, coverage and calibration gates are checked, the epoch is debited, and the signal enters the forward-test queue.
A frozen policy replays a frozen tree nightly; a deviation beyond 1e-12 halts dreaming and marks scores produced in the affected window as void.

implementation_steps.phase: Scaffold the uv workspace, the module loader and shared test configuration.

phase.name: M0 · Signal Contract · Market Data Ingest · Snapshot Sealing · Universe Survivorship · Point-in-Time Feature Store

implementation_steps.phase: Build the MarketWindow contract, the ingest workers, snapshot sealing and content addressing, the point-in-time universe, and the versioned feature store.

phase.name: M0 · Cost Model Fill Simulation · Frozen Evaluator Pipeline · Trial Ledger Accounting · Database Schema Migrations

implementation_steps.phase: Build the shared cost library, the twelve-step evaluator, the append-only ledger, and the versioned relational schema. Exit when the evaluator reproduces known results.

phase.name: M1 · Null Oracle Planted Nulls · Leakage Tripwires · Determinism Nightly Canary · Trust Zone Isolation Secrets

implementation_steps.phase: Build the encrypted sidecar and both campaign types, the tripwire suite, the determinism contract and canary, and the trust-zone credential split. Run the perturbation-stability triage experiment before investing further.

phase.name: M1 · Untrusted Code Sandbox · Tree Artifact Persistence

implementation_steps.phase: Build the gVisor sandbox with its resource and syscall limits, the artifact store, and the resident campaign arrays that make replay cheap.

Build the non-financial ground-truth worlds so pool size becomes a compute problem rather than a calendar problem. Authored worlds and ported external worlds both qualify; every world carries its source commit and dataset manifest hash, and a world whose upstream changed is refused rather than re-hashed into the pool.

phase.name: M2 · LLM Provider Tiering · Hypothesis Authoring Agent · Exploration Policy Runtime · Discovery Orchestrator Campaigns

implementation_steps.phase: Build the provider interface with recorded fixtures, the signal-authoring agent, the prefix-only policy runtime, and the campaign orchestrator. Exit with a measured fixed exploration baseline.

phase.name: M3 · Replay Engine · Objective Scoring CVaR Aggregation · Dreaming Loop Meta-Selection · Regime Coverage Strata

implementation_steps.phase: Build deterministic replay, the full objective with regime-stratified aggregation, the dreaming loop with its meta-selection guard, and the coverage ledger. This phase is the falsification gate.

phase.name: M4 · Promotion Epoch Governance · Portfolio Book Construction · Order Routing Venue Filters

implementation_steps.phase: Build pre-registered promotion with epoch retirement, human-authored book construction, and the venue-aware order router running in shadow mode.

phase.name: M5 · Risk Supervisor Kill Switches · Forward-Test Tracking · Observability Dashboards · System Invariant CI Gates

implementation_steps.phase: Build the independent risk supervisor, the forward-test service that closes the outer loop, the metrics surface, and the continuous integration gates for every stated invariant.

Write and run the end-to-end journeys against the assembled system, confirming the evaluator reproduces known results, leakage is caught, nulls stay indistinguishable, a dreaming cycle completes, and the risk supervisor flattens independently of a hung strategy process.

success_criteria.functionality: The evaluator reproduces known results and a random signal returns an information coefficient indistinguishable from zero. Survivorship bias is verifiably absent. Every deliberately leaking signal is caught by every tripwire. The KS guard confirms planted nulls stay statistically indistinguishable from real nodes in sample. A dreaming cycle completes and selects a policy revision under the meta-selection bar. The risk supervisor flattens while the strategy process is unresponsive.
success_criteria.ux: The operator reads FDR_deploy as the primary figure with its provenance triple visible, sees instrument status as three binary lamps, and sees the remaining clean epoch count at all times. No screen presents an equity curve above the fold.
success_criteria.technical_quality: Replay is bit-reproducible to 1e-12 under the nightly canary. A single policy and world replay completes in under 50 milliseconds. The trial ledger rejects UPDATE and DELETE at the role level. No symbol named is_null is reachable outside the scorer package. Every stored score carries its full provenance triple and cross-hash comparison is refused. Every node records agent_model_id. No GPU appears anywhere in the evaluation path.
